messages:
jamie (Support): FYI customer 'Parcelly' hitting intermittent 504s from hosted API over last 45m, escalated by CSM. They see spikes clustered around 17:10-17:25 UTC.

alice (SRE): Can you paste a sample request id / curl?

jamie (Support): sample: `req_8a3f4b2c` — curl shows 504 and gateway log `upstream_error: request_queue_full`.

lee (Oncall): I pulled the gateway logs for that req: `ingress.gateway: request_queue_enqueue_failed tenant=parcelly queue_depth=512 limit=512 reason=overfull`. Looks like the tenant hit the per-tenant queue cap.

mohit (Runtime): Metric dump from batchers in iad: `continuous_batcher.pending=3480`, `batcher.dequeue_rate=120/s`, `kvcache.misses=23%`, median seq len ~220 tokens. Continuous batching backlog + cold KV miss looks likely.

alice (SRE): Repro steps from our side: 1) hit their tenant with 100 rps short bursts with seq len 200-300, 2) see queue depth climb, 3) requests start 504ing at cap. Repro reliably in staging with tenant isolation.

jamie (Support): Customer timeline: they rolled a new model (longer context) ~16:50 UTC, ramped traffic 3x at 16:55. Errors start ~17:05. They reverted model at 18:00 and errors dropped.

lee (Oncall): Immediate mitigation applied: enabled temporary tenant throttling at gateway (limit 180 rps) and increased ingress burst allowance for hosted pool in iad by +10% (minutes ago). Also toggled `continuous_batching=false` for their tenant via feature-flag gate.

ops-bot: action=feature_flag_toggle tenant=parcelly continuous_batching=false user=lee

mohit (Runtime): After disabling continuous batching for tenant: `continuous_batcher.pending` dropped from 3480 -> 40 over ~3m. Queue depth back to normal, 504s stopped. p95 tail latency improved from 2.8s -> 450ms for that tenant.

alice (SRE): Root cause hypothesis: longer context caused larger aggregate batch sizes + more KV cache pressure on cold path. Continuous batching aggregated requests faster than dequeue could clear because of heavy per-token compute; queue filled and gateway started rejecting.

jamie (Support): Customer is OK with the temporary throttle/flag for now, but requested a timeline to avoid recurrence.

mohit (Runtime): Short-term engineering fixes: - add per-tenant dynamic batching caps (prevent huge batches for single tenant) - add aggressive prefix KV warmup for long-context models - expose tenant-specific queue depth metrics in Console dashboard.

alice (SRE): Operational follow-ups (this incident): 1) Update runbook: add step to toggle continuous batching per-tenant and to apply per-tenant throttle. 2) Add alert for `ingress.queue_reject_rate > 0.1%` for >2m. 3) Investigate increasing default queue_headroom for longseq-heavy models.

lee (Oncall): I filed a backlog ticket: INF-8273 "dynamic per-tenant batch caps + dashboard" and linked logs + repro script.

jamie (Support): Notes for Customer-facing postmortem: summary, mitigation (throttle + feature flag), suggested customer-side remedies (stagger ramp, use smaller context or split requests), timeline estimate from eng: ~2 sprints for soft fixes, 1-2 quarters for heavier runtime changes.

mohit (Runtime): Quick repro script for eng (put in incident artifact):
```
# stress tenant queue
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"long-context-v1","input": "${LARGE_PROMPT}","max_tokens":200}' &
done
```

alice (SRE): Follow-up checklist: - postmortem, - add alerts, - expose tenant queue metrics in Console, - consider per-tenant cold-warm KV preload.

lee (Oncall): Current status: customer reporting errors resolved, SRE will monitor 24h. I've set retention for traces to 72h for this tenant.

jamie (Support): Customer will wait for postmortem, will schedule follow-up call tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:

alice (SRE): Closing notes: immediate mitigation worked. Ownership: mohit (Runtime) for infra fixes, alice (SRE) for runbook & alerts, jamie for customer comms. Marking incident resolved but on-watch for 24h.

ops-bot: incident=6132109876 status=resolved handlers=[lee,alice,mohit,jamie]
